rows.notes: This is the adoption measurement described in the report's second-pass section: 1.103x clears the 1.05x adoption bar with an IQR clear of parity, so lookahead was adopted and is this entry's shipped configuration (unlike the 8B and Qwen3.5-0.8B rungs, which rejected lookahead). A follow-up check found flush cadence adds nothing once lookahead is running (1.002x, IQR crossing parity), which is why this entry's runtime.config.flushEvery is 0.

publishedSubgroup32StockRuntime.notes: Paired six-round published WebLLM 0.2.84 subgroup-32 baseline on the stock runtime, measured live in the same rotation as the headline row.

caveat: Absolute measured throughput was taken under sustained background ORCA/NEB load. The paired ratio is the robust headline. There is no historical quiet baseline for this model and no quiet projection is claimed. GEMV TR is a no-op for this model (byte-identical compiled WASM at 16/32/64/128); the artifact keeps its build-time -tr32 filename for traceability only.
